channel.title: Tripwire — alerts
channel.description: Hourly tripwires on 31 markets across six classes: Bitcoin to BHP, the ASX 200 to gold, AUD/USD to WTI. You name the number — or just ask for a ±5% move — and it tells you when arithmetic crosses it. Every alert lands in a hash-chained log you can verify yourself. Free quotes, free feed, free board; paid hourly email.
